scientific_integrity: Exact finite formulas independently checked by rational arithmetic and a stand-alone deterministic checker; the universal classification and limit are established by the written analytic arguments rather than finite computations. scientific_limitations: Non-atomic finite-fourth-moment iid laws only for the uniqueness theorem; exact sample-wise Watson identity requires known uniform support and its correct length; no stability theorem for near-unity correlation. Classical Watson distribution is not presented as new.
title: Uniformity as the unique perfect first-order Gini–variance alignment
